items.title: Israeli strikes kill at least four in Gaza despite Trump ceasefire breakthrough
items.summary: Investing.com -- Israeli airstrikes killed at least four Palestinians in Gaza on Sunday, continuing for a second day despite U.S. President Donald Trump announcing progress towards implementing last year’s ceasefire agreement, Reuters reported.

items.title: U.S. and allies display growing naval cooperation in Pacific drills
items.summary: Investing.com -- The U.S. and its allies conducted their largest Rim of the Pacific maritime exercise to date, demonstrating deepening military cooperation amid concerns about China and North Korea, the Wall Street Journal reported.

items.title: L3Harris (LHX) Lands Seven Year Missile Propulsion Deals For PAC 3 And THAAD
items.summary: L3Harris Technologies (NYSE:LHX) has signed multi year propulsion agreements with the Department of War and Lockheed Martin. The contracts cover missile propulsion production for the PAC 3 MSE and THAAD defense systems. The agreements are described as transformative and are intended to nearly triple and quadruple propulsion output for these programs.
